The page you were looking for isn't on this site.

The Federal Modernization Workbook now publishes its material as topic books. Pages that a published book has replaced forward to the chapter that replaced them. The workbook's other documents are being reworked into the remaining books; until each book is published, its source documents are kept in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/WhalerMike/modernization-workbook) rather than on this site.

- [The Workbook Books](https://whalermike.github.io/modernization-workbook/docs/books/index.html): all eighteen books and their status.
- [Presentations](https://whalermike.github.io/modernization-workbook/docs/presentations/index.html): the 15-minute deck for each book.
- [Site Map](https://whalermike.github.io/modernization-workbook/sitemap.html): every page on the site.
